scripts.check: pnpm run check.workspace-references && pnpm run check.tailwind-deprecations && pnpm run format.fix && pnpm run tsc
scripts.clean: npx turbo run clean && rm -rf node_modules .turbo
scripts.test: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:node test:integration:browser test:integration:claude
scripts.test:integration:browser: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:browser
scripts.test:integration:claude: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:claude
scripts.test:integration:node: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:node
